title: Meridian Bank — Fraud Alert Triage System

context.regulatory_context: FCA Consumer Duty obligations require proactive fraud detection and timely alert triage. PCI-DSS applies to all card data handling. Hard regulatory deadline: 6 months.

options.label: Regulated DoD

options.label: Minimal DoD

debrief_notes: The Meridian Bank fraud alert triage simulation tests your ability to balance Agile delivery with regulatory compliance in a UK challenger bank. Key learnings: (1) Definition of Done choices cascade through the entire project — a regulated DoD protects against later audit findings. (2) Scope management is critical when dealing with deadline-driven Product Owners. (3) Regulatory events are unpredictable — building slack into sprints and maintaining stakeholder trust gives you options when FCA guidance changes. (4) Audit readiness is not a sprint-6 activity — it must be embedded from sprint 1. (5) The change freeze is a reality in financial services — non-production sprints can still deliver value through documentation, BPMN mapping, and test automation.
